title: Spacelift Guide Group
description: Schema for group.yaml files that define a top-level group of chapters

description.description: Short summary of what the group covers

skillLevel.description: Target skill level for this group

requiredEntitlements.description: Spacelift product entitlements the user's account must have to complete the guides in this group. Values mirror the backend `Entitlement` GraphQL enum (1:1 string match); the backend maps each entitlement to its own billing / feature-flag model. Omit or leave empty when the group is available on every plan (including Free). The enum below only lists entitlements referenced by current guide groups — extend it (and the matching Entitlement constants in library.go) as new groups are added that depend on additional gated features, and make sure every new value also exists in the backend Entitlement enum.
